info.name: UVP OpenAPI v1
info.description: UVP 平台对外 OpenAPI v1（84 个接口）。导入后请在「环境管理」新建环境，前置 URL 填 http://<平台IP>:51002，并添加 accessKey / secretKey / audience 三个变量；签名由每个目录的前置脚本自动完成。

items.name: List devices owned by the authenticated machine client

query.name: page
query.description: Positive one-based page number; defaults to 1 when omitted; an explicit empty value is rejected.

query.name: pageSize
query.description: Positive page size, at most 100; defaults to 20 when omitted; an explicit empty value is rejected.

query.name: keyword
query.description: Valid UTF-8 search text, limited to 100 Unicode characters; an empty value is valid.

query.name: status
query.description: Optional device or channel status filter; an explicit empty value is rejected.

api.description:
`listDevices` · scope `device:list` · risk `read` · 幂等 `none`

List devices owned by the authenticated machine client

**Query 参数**（按需加，空值会被平台拒绝的不要留空）
- `page`（integer，默认: 1，可选）Positive one-based page number; defaults to 1 when omitted; an explicit empty value is rejected.
- `pageSize`（integer，默认: 20，可选）Positive page size, at most 100; defaults to 20 when omitted; an explicit empty value is rejected.
- `keyword`（string，可选）Valid UTF-8 search text, limited to 100 Unicode characters; an empty value is valid.
- `status`（string，取值: online / offline / unknown，可选）Optional device or channel status filter; an explicit empty value is rejected.

签名头由集合的 pre-request 脚本自动写入，不要在请求里手填。
